feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: PM is hollowing out defence, new Reform spokesperson warns
articles.summary: Andy Burnham is continuing to hollow out the armed forces just as the Conservatives did before - despite all the talk from Labour about increased investment, Reform's new defence spokesperson has said.

articles.title: Supplies critically low at 40% of food banks, Trussell warns
articles.summary: UK food banks are facing critically low levels of donations as they prepare for winter, according to a new report.

articles.title: Revealed: 10 NHS trusts that disclosed most reports of staff 'snooping' on patient records
articles.summary: The NHS trusts that disclosed the most reports of staff inappropriately accessing patient records have been revealed.

articles.title: American soldier suspected of spying for Russia handed to US authorities
articles.summary: A US soldier arrested by UK counter terror police has been taken into custody by the American military.

articles.title: Henry Nowak killer in bid to appeal against murder conviction
articles.summary: Henry Nowak's killer has applied to appeal against his murder conviction.

articles.title: Charles Bronson refused parole for ninth time
articles.summary: Charles Bronson, one of Britain's most notorious inmates, has been denied parole for the ninth time.

articles.title: Rockstar Games sacked workers to prevent union gaining 'leverage or power', tribunal told
articles.summary: The company behind the Grand Theft Auto video games sacked a group of employees to prevent a trade union gaining "leverage or power", an employment tribunal heard.

articles.title: Man in court as 'heartbroken' mother pays tribute to boy, four, killed in Range Rover crash
articles.summary: A man has appeared in court as a "heartbroken" mother has paid tribute to a four-year-old boy killed in a fatal Range Rover crash.

articles.title: Prison sentence for teen e-biker who killed woman, 86, increased after appeal
articles.summary: The prison sentence for a teen e-biker who killed an 86-year-old woman has been increased after an appeal.

articles.title: Snow warning in place for parts of UK this morning
articles.summary: A yellow alert for snow is in force for parts of the UK, with forecasters warning of possible travel disruption.
